Four Held in Odisha for Assaulting Police, Teacher Arrested for Molestation

In Odisha, four individuals were arrested in Berhampur for assaulting police officers and obstructing their duties. Separately, in Balasore, a school teacher was taken into custody for allegedly molesting a girl. Details regarding the specific circumstances of the assault on the police or the molestation case were not provided in the coverage.
